title: test_ping_endpoint_returns_pong
description: Verify the engine readiness endpoint reports the gRPC server as ready. The engine exposes run control over native gRPC, not JSON-over-HTTP endpoints.

title: test_start_run_with_valid_graph_accepts_run
description: Verify the observability/readiness surface is healthy before backend-owned tests exercise run startup through the backend control plane and native gRPC client.

title: test_start_run_with_invalid_graph_rejects_run
description: Verify the readiness response keeps reporting the native gRPC service as ready. Invalid graph rejection belongs to backend graph validation or native gRPC integration tests, not JSON-over-HTTP.

title: test_start_run_with_missing_required_fields_rejects_run
description: Verify the readiness payload remains well-formed and does not expose a misleading JSON-over-HTTP StartRun contract.

title: test_get_run_status_returns_current_status
description: Verify the engine readiness endpoint remains available. Durable run status is backend-owned and should be tested through backend run APIs.

title: test_get_run_status_for_nonexistent_run_returns_404
description: Verify an unknown HTTP path does not masquerade as a run-status API. Native gRPC status behavior is covered by engine integration tests.

title: test_cancel_run_successful_cancellation
description: Verify readiness stays healthy before backend-owned cancellation flows are exercised through backend run APIs and native gRPC coordination.

title: test_metrics_endpoint_returns_prometheus_metrics
description: Verify that the GET /metrics endpoint returns a 200 status with Prometheus metrics text representing engine health and runtime telemetry.
